readerContract.humanQuestion: AI now writes, recommends, predicts, searches, edits images and sometimes acts through tools. What is actually happening, which claims belong together and what do I need to understand to use or question it well?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: A connected, technically coherent map of current AI that lets a nontechnical reader recognise the kind of system in front of her, understand its moving parts and ask better questions about what it can do, what it used and what happens next.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No technical vocabulary, coding or engineering knowledge is assumed. The reader has encountered AI at work, at home or in the news and is tired of explanations that begin halfway through the subject.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: AI is a broad name for machine-based systems that use inputs to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations or decisions. Different systems perform different kinds of work and combine models, software, information, tools, physical computing infrastructure and human decisions in different ways.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: The opening begins with an ordinary meeting where an AI proposal is discussed as though the label itself explains the product, the work and the consequences. The reader learns how to replace the vague label with useful questions she can ask at work, at home and when reading the news.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A durable, scannable LIBRAiRY book with a connected chapter route and separate Concept Index. It is not a glossary wall, technical course, provider catalogue, product manual, episode recap or current-news article.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: Finally. I know what people are talking about, I can see how the parts fit together and I am interested enough to keep going.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Before any public review or whenever a bound primary definition, current-capability boundary or AGI/ASI position changes.
Before publication or if NIST materially changes or replaces its public AI RMF trustworthiness guidance.

templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: The route names distinct questions and mechanisms rather than repeated blocks.

decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The successor uses the direct uses-AI versus uses-software comparison and removes the dot-com analogy after Ali found the domains too different.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Use cultural detail only when it sharpens the actual point.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: The opening plan relies on specific work truth and permits no reference quota.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Give the plain AI-system mechanism before naming families.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The causal sequence binds input, system processing, output and consequence.

genericAction.producerGuard: End with questions the reader can use on a real proposal.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The useful action asks what the system does, what it uses and what follows.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Explain the familiar phenomenon before technical labels.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: Chapter 1 introduces recognisable AI encounters before generative, agentic, AGI or ASI terminology.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Keep every chapter connected to the same input-system-output-consequence map.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The route progresses from kinds to parts, learning, current information, tools, agents, failures, data and consequences.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Write as an enthusiastic best friend with precise human observations.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: The opening plan begins in a recognisable meeting and builds curiosity through the absurdity of a label pretending to be an explanation.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Serve work, home and public judgment rather than one task.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: The reader payoff covers use, questioning and consequential participation.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Earn the technical question through a situation the reader already encounters.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: The meeting scene comes before the plain system definition.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Use the meeting only to open the question, then widen deliberately.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The route and payoff extend across nine chapters and a Concept Index.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Apply the complete canonical best-friend voice across the opening.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: Episode 1 is bound for relationship, pacing, warmth and specificity rather than isolated jokes.

opaqueChapterTitles.producerGuard: Every title tells an unfamiliar reader what she will learn.
opaqueChapterTitles.preventionEvidence: Each readerRoute title names AI plus its exact subject or distinction.

prerequisiteOrderHiddenByTitles.producerGuard: Put kinds before parts and parts before training/use distinctions.
prerequisiteOrderHiddenByTitles.preventionEvidence: Every route entry names its prerequisite and appears after it.

abstractStakesBeforeFeltRelevance.producerGuard: Begin with a moment the reader can picture and a decision she may face.
abstractStakesBeforeFeltRelevance.preventionEvidence: The opening meeting supplies felt relevance before institutional stakes.

institutionalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Use conversational precision, enthusiasm and point of view.
institutionalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: The planned opening addresses the reader directly and treats vague corporate AI language as the problem to solve.

isolatedWitFalsePositive.producerGuard: Judge voice across the whole section, never by one joke.
isolatedWitFalsePositive.preventionEvidence: The producer review must cite section-local evidence for relationship, enthusiasm, clarity, humour and practical usefulness.

purposeAssertedNotEarned.producerGuard: Show the reader the decisions already shaped by AI before stating the payoff.
purposeAssertedNotEarned.preventionEvidence: The opening moves from work proposal to everyday recommendations, search and services before naming the book promise.

borrowedSectionEvidence.producerGuard: Every section proves its own voice, mechanism and payoff.
borrowedSectionEvidence.preventionEvidence: The representative opening will be reviewed as a standalone exact artifact.

missingExplanatoryClick.producerGuard: Resolve the opening mystery with one reusable three-question lens.
missingExplanatoryClick.preventionEvidence: The earned click is that AI is not one object; useful understanding begins with what it does, what it uses and what happens next.

taxonomyBeforeOrientation.producerGuard: Orient through familiar encounters before organising types.
taxonomyBeforeOrientation.preventionEvidence: The Introduction explains the broad system idea; Chapter 1 begins with recognisable examples rather than axes.

labelsBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Give every term a plain phenomenon before its name.
labelsBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: Generative, predictive, agentic, embodied, AGI and ASI enter only after the reader can picture the question each answers.

cognitiveOverloadAtEntry.producerGuard: Teach one distinction at a time.
cognitiveOverloadAtEntry.preventionEvidence: The opening contains one system definition and one three-question lens; the family relationships wait for Chapter 1.

canonicalVoiceAbsentAcrossArtifact.producerGuard: Require the full LAiDIES teaching relationship across every paragraph.
canonicalVoiceAbsentAcrossArtifact.preventionEvidence: The paragraph plan assigns human recognition, contagious curiosity, mechanism, humour and useful action throughout.

decorativeWorldReference.producerGuard: Do not mention SUNNYVAiLE or the Rewind Era merely to brand the prose.
decorativeWorldReference.preventionEvidence: No town or cultural analogy is planned for the representative opening.

unfaithfulAnalogyMapping.producerGuard: Omit the analogy unless it is faithful, simpler and transfer-producing.
unfaithfulAnalogyMapping.preventionEvidence: No Rewind Era analogy is used in the opening; the mechanism is simpler and clearer without one.

selfReviewEvidenceBorrowing.producerGuard: Bind every finding to exact local prose.
selfReviewEvidenceBorrowing.preventionEvidence: The successor review will use only excerpts from the opening proof for opening outcomes.

technicalTidinessMistakenForTeaching.producerGuard: Require reader understanding, not category neatness.
technicalTidinessMistakenForTeaching.preventionEvidence: The route is question-led and the proof ends in a usable diagnostic lens.

technicallyIncoherentCategories.producerGuard: Never compare task, model, product, operating pattern and speculative capability as peers.
technicallyIncoherentCategories.preventionEvidence: Chapter 1 separates what a system produces, how it operates and how broad a capability claim is before relating the terms.

analogyCheckboxWithoutLearningGain.producerGuard: An analogy requires observed learning gain or is omitted.
analogyCheckboxWithoutLearningGain.preventionEvidence: The dot-com comparison was removed when Ali found its domain differences more distracting than helpful.

witWithoutContagiousEnthusiasm.producerGuard: Do not mistake isolated jokes or wry scepticism for the complete LAiDIES relationship; sustain visible delight in understanding the subject.
witWithoutContagiousEnthusiasm.preventionEvidence: The repaired opening now expresses excitement when an AI result surprises the reader, when the shared mechanism becomes visible and when the system becomes explorable.

technicalTermMeaningPlantedBeforeDefinit.producerGuard: Reserve technical terms for their defined meaning and remove earlier colloquial uses that would interfere with learning.
technicalTermMeaningPlantedBeforeDefinit.preventionEvidence: The machine no longer arrives with its own objectives; the sentence now says it has its own plan for the afternoon, preserving objective for its later technical explanation.

diagnosticVerbWithoutWorkedAnchor.producerGuard: Every verb in a reusable diagnostic must already have a concrete worked anchor nearby.
diagnosticVerbWithoutWorkedAnchor.preventionEvidence: The five worked examples now explicitly anchor recognise, predict, rank, recommend, generate and act before the diagnostic.

exampleCountMismatch.producerGuard: Count every announced example against the actual list before self-review.
exampleCountMismatch.preventionEvidence: The introduction now announces five examples and contains exactly five bullets.

workedExampleDiagnosticDrift.producerGuard: Map each diagnostic verb to one exact demonstrated action before drafting and preserve the mapping in the recap.
workedExampleDiagnosticDrift.preventionEvidence: Phone-recognise, spam-predict, streaming-rank-and-recommend, image-generate and travel-act now appear consistently in example, recap and diagnostic.

recapCapabilityNotShown.producerGuard: A recap may only name capabilities already shown in its worked example.
recapCapabilityNotShown.preventionEvidence: The travel recap now repeats search, comparison and continued action; it no longer adds generation.

synonymIntroducedAtTransfer.producerGuard: Use the taught diagnostic vocabulary at transfer; do not silently substitute a nearby everyday verb.
synonymIntroducedAtTransfer.preventionEvidence: The return to the meeting repeats recognises, predicts, ranks, recommends, generates and acts instead of introducing drafts.

preciseTermReusedAsGenericOutput.producerGuard: Once a term has a precise diagnostic job, never reuse it as a generic stand-in.
preciseTermReusedAsGenericOutput.preventionEvidence: The responsibility paragraph now says output rather than using recommendation to mean every possible result.

suggestedVersusExecutedActionBlur.producerGuard: Whenever an example moves from output to action, state the permission and execution boundary consistently.
suggestedVersusExecutedActionBlur.preventionEvidence: Both the travel example and recap now say that connected tools take actions only if the system has permission.

foundationDoesNotContainDiagnostic.producerGuard: The foundational answer must explicitly locate every behaviour used in the first diagnostic.
foundationDoesNotContainDiagnostic.preventionEvidence: The definition now places recognise, predict, rank and generate as tasks, recommendation and other results as outputs, and action as a permitted downstream step.

localEnthusiasmDominatedByMockingRegiste.producerGuard: Judge the dominant emotional register; passion for understanding must outweigh scepticism or mockery.
localEnthusiasmDominatedByMockingRegiste.preventionEvidence: The opening now begins with the exciting possibility, celebrates the invisible process becoming visible, and closes on why mechanism makes remarkable results more interesting; three mocking lines were removed.

highStakesHarmFlattenedInChecklist.producerGuard: Give consequential human harm visible weight and a bounded reason for greater scrutiny.
highStakesHarmFlattenedInChecklist.preventionEvidence: A separate paragraph contrasts a low-stakes recommendation with outputs affecting opportunity, money, health or safety and calls for stronger evidence in those contexts.

downstreamActionInsideTaskDiagnostic.producerGuard: The task question cannot absorb downstream permission or execution.
downstreamActionInsideTaskDiagnostic.preventionEvidence: Act now appears only under what happens after the output; the first question covers recognise, predict, rank, recommend and generate.

harmFramedAsWonder.producerGuard: Separate beneficial surprise from harmful failure before assigning emotional meaning.
harmFramedAsWonder.preventionEvidence: The astonishing-results paragraph now contains successful examples; fraud failure begins a separate paragraph explicitly framed as a different jolt.

analogyDomainDifferencesOvertakeMapping.producerGuard: Never compare AI, an AI bubble or a possible AI correction/collapse to the dot-com boom or collapse.
analogyDomainDifferencesOvertakeMapping.preventionEvidence: The dot-com comparison is removed; the direct uses-AI versus uses-software explanation performs the job without historical equivalence.

introDiagnosticBecomesIncompleteTaxonomy.producerGuard: The Introduction asks for the concrete result instead of pretending to supply an exhaustive task taxonomy.
introDiagnosticBecomesIncompleteTaxonomy.preventionEvidence: The first practical question now asks what result the system produces and anchors it in four customer-service outputs.

decisionBlursOutputActionAndGovernance.producerGuard: Do not use decision as a generic machine output when nearby prose teaches human governance and downstream action.
decisionBlursOutputActionAndGovernance.preventionEvidence: Decision is removed from the output definition; proposed refund and issued refund preserve suggestion versus action.

routeReintroducesResolvedActionError.producerGuard: The book route must preserve every distinction established in the admitted opening.
routeReintroducesResolvedActionError.preventionEvidence: Chapter 1 no longer lists act as a peer capability and explicitly keeps tool use as a separate product operation.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: AI is a broad name for machine-based systems that take inputs and generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations or decisions. The useful questions are what this system does, what information and components it uses, and what happens after its output.
causalSequence: A person or another system supplies an objective and input.
An AI system processes that input through one or more models plus surrounding software or rules.
The system produces an output such as a prediction, recommendation, content or decision.
People, software or machines may use that output, creating consequences that depend on the complete system and context.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A leadership meeting announces that a customer-support process will get AI. The reader replaces the label with questions about whether it drafts replies, predicts routing, searches policy, acts through tools or changes customer outcomes.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A phone photo feature, a streaming recommendation and a multi-step travel assistant all use AI differently; the reader applies the same three questions without forcing them into one type.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: When someone says AI, ask: what does it do; what information, model and tools does it use; and what happens after the output?

humourPlan.lessonJob: The humour comes from the precise corporate habit of announcing an AI initiative as though the label is a complete plan; it sharpens why the reader needs better questions.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: A persuasive Introduction followed by nine logically sequenced chapters, a final synthesis and a separate Concept Index. Every substantive section has a teaching goal and answerable outcome questions; headings remain natural and coverage-predictive rather than compulsory questions.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No repeated mini-sections, type axes, glossary parade, fact-box quota or branded callout. The opening uses a natural narrative-to-mechanism arc.

systemSynthesis.endState: The reader can reconstruct purpose and training into a model; place that model inside a product with current context retrieval and tools; follow output into optional action human decision consequence evaluation and correction; and add infrastructure and institutional actors around the loop.
systemSynthesis.drawPrompt: From a blank page draw the AI ecosystem with arrows from human purpose and training inputs through model product current information output optional action decision consequence evaluation and correction; mark optional parts as optional.
systemSynthesis.explainBackPrompt: Choose one familiar AI product and explain in ordinary language how its parts work together why they matter and where a human choice remains.
systemSynthesis.applicationPrompt: Analyse an unfamiliar workplace AI proposal; identify present absent and unknown parts predict two plausible failure locations and name one useful next question or safeguard.

entries.title: Why understanding AI changes what you can do and decide
entries.teachingGoal: Give the reader a compelling reason to understand AI and the first complete map she can use immediately.
questionsAnswered: Why does understanding AI matter in my ordinary decisions and work?
What does the label AI tell me and leave unanswered?
What first questions make an AI claim more concrete?
entries.coverage: The human reason, broad system answer and useful questions that guide the book.
connectionsAdded: An AI label becomes useful only when input system output and consequence are traced.
entries.readerCanNow: Replace a vague AI claim with three useful questions.

entries.title: The kinds of AI you are already meeting
entries.teachingGoal: Orient the reader to major kinds and capability claims without presenting unlike labels as one flat taxonomy.
questionsAnswered: Why do very different products all count as AI?
What do predictive generative multimodal and agentic describe?
What are AGI and ASI and do they exist today?
entries.coverage: Predictive, recognising, generative, agentic and embodied systems plus careful AGI and ASI orientation.
connectionsAdded: Different labels describe tasks behaviours or disputed breadth claims and may overlap.
entries.readerCanNow: Classify a product provisionally by observed behaviour without treating every label as a competing type.

entries.title: What an AI product is made of
entries.teachingGoal: Separate the visible product from the model and surrounding technical and human components.
questionsAnswered: What is an AI model?
What else makes an AI product work?
Why can the same model behave differently in different products?
entries.coverage: Product, model, inputs, surrounding software, infrastructure, tools, output and people.
connectionsAdded: A trained model runs as one component inside a product shaped by software information tools and people.
entries.readerCanNow: Draw the major parts behind a familiar AI product and keep model product and company distinct.

entries.title: How an AI model learns, then produces a result
entries.teachingGoal: Explain how a model is built adjusted and evaluated then distinguish that process from using it on a new input.
questionsAnswered: How does machine learning differ from ordinary programmed rules?
What happens during training?
What are tokens parameters neural networks and transformers?
How are training post-training evaluation and inference different?
entries.coverage: Machine learning, neural networks, tokens, embeddings, transformers, training, parameters, evaluation, generalisation, post-training and inference.
connectionsAdded: Training adjusts model parameters while inference uses the trained model on a current input.
entries.readerCanNow: Explain training versus inference and show where examples objectives architecture and evaluation shape behaviour.

entries.title: What information an AI product can use right now
entries.teachingGoal: Separate what the model learned during training from what the product supplies or stores for a current request.
questionsAnswered: What information can an AI product use right now?
How are context retrieval and memory different?
Why might visible information still be absent from the model's current input?
entries.coverage: Training knowledge, prompts, instructions, context, context window, files, conversation state, retrieval, RAG and memory.
connectionsAdded: Current context retrieval and memory supplement but do not become the same thing as trained parameters.
entries.readerCanNow: Trace which information was actually available for one result and identify what was missing.

entries.title: How AI systems use tools and take actions
entries.teachingGoal: Trace the boundary between model output and an action executed through connected software under permissions.
questionsAnswered: How does an AI product use a tool?
What is the difference between connection permission and execution?
How can I tell whether an action actually happened?
entries.coverage: Tools, APIs, connectors, permissions, execution, observations and human confirmation.
connectionsAdded: A model may propose a tool call but connected software and permissions determine whether an action executes.
entries.readerCanNow: Distinguish a suggested action from an executed one and locate the permission boundary.

entries.title: What makes agentic AI different from automation
entries.teachingGoal: Distinguish fixed automation governed workflows and agentic loops including their control and failure implications.
questionsAnswered: What makes an AI system agentic?
How is an agent different from automation or a workflow?
Why can errors compound across steps?
entries.coverage: Agent loops, workflows, planning, state, tools, stopping, escalation and compounding error.
connectionsAdded: Agentic systems repeatedly use outputs observations state and tools toward a goal while automation may follow a fixed route.
entries.readerCanNow: Draw an agent loop and place a useful human checkpoint before errors compound.

entries.title: Why AI systems fail in different ways
entries.teachingGoal: Give the reader a system-level failure map so different problems receive different diagnoses and responses.
questionsAnswered: What is a hallucination?
How are unreliability brittleness bias manipulation and misuse different?
How do I locate the failure before choosing a safeguard?
entries.coverage: Model, data, context, retrieval, tool, interface, workflow and human failure locations.
connectionsAdded: Similar visible failures can originate in different system layers and therefore need different responses.
entries.readerCanNow: Locate a failure before proposing a remedy and explain why one generic verification instruction is insufficient.

entries.title: Where your data goes in an AI product
entries.teachingGoal: Trace information through the complete product lifecycle and make product-specific privacy checks possible.
questionsAnswered: What can happen to information I provide?
What is the difference between current processing storage retrieval and possible training use?
Which product account and workplace settings must I check?
entries.coverage: Collection, use, storage, retrieval, sharing, possible training use, retention and deletion.
connectionsAdded: Information may move through context storage retrieval sharing or model-improvement paths depending on product and account configuration.
entries.readerCanNow: Draw a possible data path and identify which product-specific facts must be checked before sharing.

entries.title: How AI connects to work, resources and public choices
entries.teachingGoal: Extend the technical system into the wider AI ecosystem of organisations infrastructure work markets governance and public consequences.
questionsAnswered: Who builds supplies deploys governs and is affected by AI systems?
How do chips cloud services data centres and energy connect to AI products?
How can I separate current evidence from forecasts about work society and the future?
entries.coverage: Ecosystem actors, chips, GPUs, cloud, data centres, open and closed access, tasks, organisations, labour, resources, standards, governance and dated claims.
connectionsAdded: Technical systems sit inside organisations infrastructure markets communities and public rules that shape consequences.
entries.readerCanNow: Extend the technical map into the wider ecosystem and identify who makes which consequential choices.

entries.title: Draw it, explain it, use it
entries.teachingGoal: Prove that the learner owns one connected model she can reconstruct explain and use without reproducing the book's wording.
questionsAnswered: Can I explain how the complete AI ecosystem fits together?
Can I analyse an unfamiliar AI product or proposal?
Can I identify what is present absent unknown and consequential?
entries.coverage: Blank-page reconstruction, ordinary-language explanation and unseen practical application.
connectionsAdded: The learner integrates technical and institutional layers into one usable model.
entries.readerCanNow: Reconstruct explain and apply the complete AI ecosystem model.

entries.title: Concept Index: find the AI term you need
entries.teachingGoal: Support direct lookup without separating a term from its prerequisites mechanism and ecosystem relationship.
questionsAnswered: What does this term mean in plain language?
Where is it taught in the connected sequence?
What is it related to or commonly confused with?
entries.coverage: A-to-Z meanings, chapter anchors, adjacent distinctions and system relationships.
connectionsAdded: Every lookup term returns to its chapter relationship inside the complete AI system map.
entries.readerCanNow: Find one term directly and recover its mechanism prerequisites and wider-system connection.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Use a continuous, scannable book opening that earns curiosity, explains the broad mechanism and hands the reader a reusable question. Do not imitate a talk, television script, Hannah Fry or Episode 1's plot.

humanQuestion.reason: Readers already encounter AI labels in consequential work and life decisions.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Open inside a meeting where everyone is asked to approve an AI initiative that nobody has actually described.

usefulCuriosity.reason: The absurd range of things called AI creates a real question the mechanism can answer.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Contrast familiar AI encounters, then ask what they genuinely share.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: The word AI hides inputs, processing, outputs and downstream use.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Trace the meeting proposal through the three questions without a diagram or analogy.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: A work proposal lets the reader move naturally into the technical system definition and back to a decision.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from the meeting to the OECD-compatible system explanation, then return with questions the reader can ask.

limitationsConsequences.reason: The AI label cannot establish usefulness, accuracy, fairness, authority or responsibility.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Name what the broad definition does and does not tell the reader before she approves or trusts anything.

humourSurprise.reason: Specific corporate absurdity makes the empty label memorable without displacing the mechanism.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Treat the phrase AI-powered transformation as the meeting equivalent of arriving with a scented marker and calling it a strategy.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The opening must change how the reader interrogates the next system she meets.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: Land on what does it do, what does it use and what happens next.

explanationArc.sharedStartingPoint: A leadership meeting asks the reader to react to an AI initiative without explaining the system.
explanationArc.curiosityGap: How can a recommendation, generated email, fraud alert and tool-using assistant all be AI without being the same thing?
mechanismSequence: A system receives an objective and inputs.
It processes them through models, rules or surrounding software.
It produces a prediction, content, recommendation or decision.
People or machines use that output, creating the real consequence.
explanationArc.earnedClick: AI is the broad family name, not the complete diagnosis; the useful understanding begins with what this system does, what it uses and what follows.
explanationArc.smallLanding: The next time a meeting slide says AI, the reader has three better questions before anyone buys licences or rearranges a department.
explanationArc.safetyBoundary: State immediately that the AI label alone does not establish accuracy, safety, fairness, usefulness or responsibility.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: The prose could again sound technically tidy while remaining emotionally flat, over-classified or incoherent.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: One complete Introduction of roughly 1,200 to 1,800 words plus the full question-led book route, with no visual and no analogy unless the plain mechanism proves insufficient.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: An unfamiliar nontechnical reader can explain the broad input-system-output-consequence model, say why the AI label is insufficient and use the three questions on a different AI example while recognising the canonical LAiDIES voice.
